title: Reset monthly position cumulative statistics without deleting assignments
changes: Admin can begin position counting from the selected month for all displayed staff or an individual.
Past daily position assignments are retained; month statistics are unchanged, only as-of-month cumulative numbers restart at saved reset date.
Changes require confirmation and a reason, are secured by an admin-only RPC, and are recorded in audit.
Historic months still display correct as-of-month counts; roster, overtime and slot configurations remain unchanged.
notes: Install SQL v670 in Supabase after backup before using reset. Use UPDATE ONLY only over v669; do not run reset until a staging test.
